title: Kinds of Expression (1st)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.217 Numbered Discourses 4.217
  • 22. Parisāvagga 22. Assembly

Paṭhamavohārapathasutta Kinds of Expression (1st)

…pe… Adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti …pe… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti. “Someone with four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. … They say they’ve seen, heard, thought, or known something, but they haven’t. … Someone with four qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. … They say they haven’t seen, heard, thought, or known something, and they haven’t. …”

Sattamaṁ.
